features.feature_name: Balanced disk type support in GcpDiskType
features.feature_summary: Supports the balanced disk type in the GcpDiskType runbook field for batch migrations using waves.
features.extended_definition: Supports the balanced disk type in the GcpDiskType runbook field for batch migrations using waves.

features.feature_name: Automatic license assignment for offline migration
features.feature_summary: Extends automatic license assignment to the offline migration flow.
features.extended_definition: Extends automatic license assignment to the offline migration flow.

features.feature_name: Automatic VDDK max open sessions adjustment
features.feature_summary: Automatically adjusts VDDK max open sessions when accessing vSphere 6.5 to avoid exceeding connection limits.
features.extended_definition: Automatically adjusts VDDK max open sessions when accessing vSphere 6.5 to avoid exceeding connection limits.

features.feature_name: Google Cloud OS Config agent auto-deployment
features.feature_summary: Automatically deploys the Google Cloud OS Config agent to migrating virtual machines.
features.extended_definition: Automatically deploys the Google Cloud OS Config agent to migrating virtual machines.

features.feature_name: Manager and Cloud Extensions connectivity over port 443
features.feature_summary: Moves backend communication between the Manager and Cloud Extensions to HTTPS/TLS over port 443 instead of port 9111.
features.extended_definition: Moves backend communication between the Manager and Cloud Extensions to HTTPS/TLS over port 443 instead of port 9111.

features.feature_summary: Lets you store Migrate for Compute Engine passwords and encryption keys in Secret Manager.
features.extended_definition: Lets you store Migrate for Compute Engine passwords and encryption keys in Secret Manager.

features.feature_summary: Supports updating the vCenter certificate during migration workflows.
features.extended_definition: Supports updating the vCenter certificate during migration workflows.

features.feature_summary: Supports upgrading Windows Server 2008 R2 to Windows Server 2012 R2 during migration using bring-your-own-license.
features.extended_definition: Supports upgrading Windows Server 2008 R2 to Windows Server 2012 R2 during migration using bring-your-own-license.

features.feature_summary: Migrates virtual machines from Azure to Compute Engine using Waves migration; Migrates virtual machines from Azure to Compute Engine using Waves migration.
features.extended_definition: Migrates virtual machines from Azure to Compute Engine using Waves migration; Migrates virtual machines from Azure to Compute Engine using Waves migration.

features.feature_name: Reduced network connectivity between Cloud Extensions and Manager
features.feature_summary: Reduces connectivity between Cloud Extensions and the Manager to single-direction traffic for system deployment.
features.extended_definition: Reduces connectivity between Cloud Extensions and the Manager to single-direction traffic for system deployment.

features.feature_summary: Provides in-product management for system upgrades and patch installation.
features.extended_definition: Provides in-product management for system upgrades and patch installation.

features.feature_summary: Migrate for Compute Engine can enable Shielded VM Secure Boot during migration runbooks.
features.extended_definition: Migrate for Compute Engine can enable Shielded VM Secure Boot during migration runbooks.

features.feature_summary: Migrate for Compute Engine can migrate UEFI-based virtual machines to Google Cloud UEFI-enabled hosts.
features.extended_definition: Migrate for Compute Engine can migrate UEFI-based virtual machines to Google Cloud UEFI-enabled hosts.

features.feature_summary: Migrate for Compute Engine can migrate Windows Server 2019 operating systems to Google Cloud.
features.extended_definition: Migrate for Compute Engine can migrate Windows Server 2019 operating systems to Google Cloud.
